verses.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.pt: Eis que reinará um rei com justiça, e com retidão governarão príncipes.
verses.en_web: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.
verses.en_bbe: See, a king will be ruling in righteousness, and chiefs will give right decisions.

verses.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.pt: um varão servirá de abrigo contra o vento, e um refúgio contra a tempestade, como ribeiros de águas em lugares secos, e como a sombra duma grande penha em terra sedenta.
verses.en_web: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.
verses.en_bbe: And a man will be as a safe place from the wind, and a cover from the storm; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shade of a great rock in a waste land.

verses.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.pt: Os olhos dos que vêem não se ofuscarão, e os ouvidos dos que ouvem escutarão.
verses.en_web: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
verses.en_bbe: And the eyes of those who see will not be shut, and those who have hearing will give ear to the word.

verses.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.pt: O coração dos imprudentes entenderá o conhecimento, e a língua dos gagos estará pronta para falar distintamente.
verses.en_web: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
verses.en_bbe: The man of sudden impulses will become wise in heart, and he whose tongue is slow will get the power of talking clearly.

verses.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
verses.pt: Ao tolo nunca mais se chamará nobre, e do avarento nunca mais se dirá que é generoso.
verses.en_web: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
verses.en_bbe: The foolish man will no longer be named noble, and they will not say of the false man that he is a man of honour.

verses.en: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.pt: Pois o tolo fala tolices, e o seu coração trama iniqüidade, para cometer profanação e proferir mentiras contra o Senhor, para deixar com fome o faminto e fazer faltar a bebida ao sedento.
verses.en_web: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, To make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.en_bbe: For the foolish man will say foolish things, having evil thoughts in his heart, working what is unclean, and talking falsely about the Lord, to keep food from him who is in need of it, and water from him whose soul is desiring it.

verses.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.pt: Também as maquinações do fraudulento são más; ele maquina invenções malignas para destruir os mansos com palavras falsas, mesmo quando o pobre fala o que é reto.
verses.en_web: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
verses.en_bbe: The designs of the false are evil, purposing the destruction of the poor man by false words, even when he is in the right.

verses.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.pt: Mas o nobre projeta coisas nobres; e nas coisas nobres persistirá.
verses.en_web: But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.
verses.en_bbe: But the noble-hearted man has noble purposes, and by these he will be guided.

verses.en: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.pt: Levantai-vos, mulheres que estais sossegadas e ouvi a minha voz; e vós, filhas, que estais , tão seguras, inclinai os ouvidos às minhas palavras.
verses.en_web: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to my voice, you women who are living in comfort; give attention to my words, you daughters who have no fear of danger.

verses.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.pt: Num ano e dias vireis a ser perturbadas, ó mulheres que tão seguras estais; pois a vindima falhará, e a colheita não virá.
verses.en_web: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage shall fail. The harvest won’t come.
verses.en_bbe: In not much more than a year, you, who are not looking for evil, will be troubled: for the produce of the vine-gardens will be cut off, and there will be no getting in of the grapes.

verses.en: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.pt: Tremei, mulheres que estais sossegadas, e turbai-vos, vós que estais tão seguras; despi-vos e ponde-vos nuas, e cingi com saco os vossos lombos.
verses.en_web: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
verses.en_bbe: Be shaking with fear, you women who are living in comfort; be troubled, you who have no fear of danger: take off your robes and put on clothing of grief.

verses.en: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.pt: Batei nos peitos pelos campos aprazíveis, e pela vinha frutífera;
verses.en_web: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.en_bbe: Have sorrow for the fields, the pleasing fields, the fertile vine;

verses.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.pt: pela terra do meu povo, que produz espinheiros e sarças, e por todas as casas de alegria, na cidade jubilosa.
verses.en_web: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
verses.en_bbe: And for the land of my people, where thorns will come up; even for all the houses of joy in the glad town.

verses.en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.pt: Porque o palácio será abandonado, a cidade populosa ficará deserta; e o outeiro e a torre da guarda servirão de cavernas para sempre, para alegria dos asnos monteses, e para pasto dos rebanhos;
verses.en_web: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks;
verses.en_bbe: For the fair houses will have no man living in them; the town which was full of noise will become a waste; the hill and the watchtower will be unpeopled for ever, a joy for the asses of the woods, a place of food for the flocks;

verses.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.pt: até que se derrame sobre nós o espírito lá do alto, e o deserto se torne em campo fértil, e o campo fértil seja reputado por um bosque.
verses.en_web: Until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.
verses.en_bbe: Till the spirit comes on us from on high, and the waste land becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field is changed into a wood.

verses.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.pt: Então o juízo habitará no deserto, e a justiça morará no campo fértil.
verses.en_web: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
verses.en_bbe: Then in the waste land there will be an upright rule, and righteousness will have its place in the fertile field.

verses.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.pt: E a obra da justiça será paz; e o efeito da justiça será sossego e segurança para sempre.
verses.en_web: The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
verses.en_bbe: And the work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of an upright rule will be to take away fear for ever.

verses.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.pt: O meu povo habitará em morada de paz, em moradas bem seguras, e em lugares quietos de descanso.
verses.en_web: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
verses.en_bbe: And my people will be living in peace, in houses where there is no fear, and in quiet resting-places.

verses.en: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.pt: Mas haverá saraiva quando cair o bosque; e a cidade será inteiramente abatida.
verses.en_web: Though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
verses.en_bbe: But the tall trees will come down with a great fall, and the town will be low in a low place.

verses.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados sois vós os que semeais junto a todas as águas, que deixais livres os pés do boi e do jumento.
verses.en_web: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are you who are planting seed by all the waters, and sending out the ox and the ass.
